title: a CLAUDE.md that is a link to AGENTS.md is the same file: the block is written and removed once, and the next run is nothing to do
source: intended: owner decision (v0.2): JITSO writes instruction blocks to AGENTS.md files only; targets that resolve to the same real file are one target
intent: INTENDED behavior (setup instructions writes AGENTS.md only, targets deduplicated by real path). `CLAUDE.md` is a symbolic link to `AGENTS.md`. The block an add writes to `AGENTS.md` must not be read back through `CLAUDE.md` as an old block to take out. The add writes `AGENTS.md` once and adds the note `note: CLAUDE.md is the same file as AGENTS.md`; a second add is `nothing to do`; `--remove` gives `AGENTS.md` its original bytes, and the link is never written through.

stdout: note: CLAUDE.md is the same file as AGENTS.md

stdout.equals: jitso setup instructions: nothing to do (the JITSO block is up to date in AGENTS.md)
